replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
It looks nice, but we need to reconsider the gladiator maps. Out of most of the maps submitted to Avicus that are TDM, almost all of them have the gladiator touch. I can name 4 maps in repo that are like this, and it's time to buckle down.

I personally like the puzzle design, but it'd be way better as something else.
